sanskrit:
अजोऽपि सन्नव्ययात्मा भूतानामीश्वरोऽपि सन् ।
प्रकृतिं स्वामधिष्ठाय सम्भवाम्यात्ममायया ॥ ४-६॥
iast:
ajo’pi sannavyayātmā bhūtānāmīśvaro’pi san
prakṛtiṃ svāmadhiṣṭhāya sambhavāmyātmamāyayā 4-6
translation: Though I am unborn and am of imperishable nature, and though I am the Lord of all beings, yet, ruling over My own Nature, I take birth by My own MAYA.
